justification: Both surfaces depict human figures and profile quadrupeds arranged in linear groupings, but that is as generic as it gets: A is dominated by boats with crew-stroke rows, cup marks, footprint-like shapes and tiny schematic stick figures scattered over an open rock face, while B shows a tight, naturalistic procession of bearded men leading horned rams above a rosette border. The rendering conventions are opposite — flat silhouette pecking with no interior detail versus modelled relief with fleece texture, curled horns, hair and garments — and no specific motif or relationship recurs.
